eod.conclusion: Indian equities extended their rally with significant percentage gains across major indices, though momentum faded slightly by the close. The session was characterized by reduced volatility and sustained buying interest, with investors focusing on corporate earnings for directional cues. While domestic markets maintained their upward trajectory, global tech sentiment showed mixed signals amid AI-related concerns and deal activity.
